name: The Tale-Telling Heart
desc: A group of people, each with their own story to tell, lights a bonfire at Blue Amber Lake...

customize.text: Unlock Requirements

<color=#ffffff73>Head to the group of people surrounding a campfire in</color> <color=#ece5d8>Blue Amber Lake</color> <color=#ffffff73>.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Location -</color> <color=#ece5d8>Blue Amber Lake, Nod-Krai</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Teleport to one of the nearby waypoints and go to the quest location.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>The quest starts automatically by going to the group of people around the campfire.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Check near the campfire</color>
<color=#ffffff73>To start the quest, go to the people around the campfire.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Collect Stellafruit, deliver them to Sergeant Octopus, and pass the trial</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Now,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>must find the Stellafruits scattered nearby.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Most of them can be found inside the Rippleweeds surrounding the lake, which may require</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>to utilize the kuuvahki mechanic to open them.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Remember that</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>needs to stand in a spot brimming with kuuvahki in order to have access to its mechanics.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>When in kuuhenki form,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>may carry objects with kuuvahki farther than</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>normally would. Use this to solve some of the puzzles.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>With 12 Stellafruits,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>must take them to the two Sergeant Octopi in the encroaches of the lake</color>

<color=#ffffff73>After delivering 12 Stellafruit to one of them,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>will have to pass a challenge that involves popping 99 Stellafruit.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>In one challenge,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>must use kuuvahki rocks to destroy all Stellafruit.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>In the other,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>must touch the Stellafruit to destroy them. The available Unipolar Fields allow</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>to jump higher than usual. The polarity can be inverted by executing Plunging Attacks.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Return to Colonel Iron Whale</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Wake Colonel Iron Whale up</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Go to the indicated area atop the ship.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Some nearby kuuvahki energy zones allow</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>to jump higher than normal.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Head to the designated location</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Talk to Tolfin</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Go to the indicated area, a lift will take the player up to the quest location.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>The lever is missing, and a weasel stole it!</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Tolfin sends his own weasel friend, Huginn, to chase the thief.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Find the missing lift parts</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Follow the weasel thief to the nearby area</color>
<color=#ffffff73>A group of Treasure Hoarders is present, and more will appear when</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>gets closer to the location</color>
<color=#ffffff73>The following enemies will appear during this quest to reinforce the usual Treasure Hoarders camp</color>

customize.name: Treasure Hoarders: Handyman
customize.desc:
A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.
These members do physical work and are lower on the pecking order. They are often laughed at for their physique — but when the gang comes under attack, they get a chance to show their unexpectedly high strength and agility.

customize.name: Treasure Hoarders - Marksman
customize.desc:
A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.
Though they are called "marksmen," this name has an undercurrent of mockery to it, as they use crossbows instead of bows, which require a long period of training to use. It must be said that even hilichurls know how to operate a crossbow. Just point the wider end at the enemy, pull the trigger, and bam — that's all there is to it.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff73>Defeat them all and Huginn will appear with the recovered lever.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Go to it to acquire the parts.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Activate the lift</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Enter the workshop below</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Put the lever in its place and ride the lift.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Follow Huginn and look for clues</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Follow Huginn forward.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>At first,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>will come across a group of enemies</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>must defeat.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>The following enemies will appear:</color>

customize.name: Blazing Axe Mitachurl
customize.desc:
Muscular hilichurls who wield large two-handed axes.
Attacks with large strikes, and will use Pyro Slimes to infuse their axes with Pyro. They are very lethal.
Usually, repeatedly quenching a weapon the way a Blazing Axe Mitachurl does will decrease the hardness of the metal and cause the axe-head's edge to chip more easily. But such is the strength of the mitachurls that even should the edge disappear altogether, they can still use their axes as hammers.

customize.name: Hilichurl
customize.desc:
The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.
They look very similar to humanity but seem to have lost both their intellect and spirituality. Their presence on the continent has been recorded for over a thousand years, and yet they have neither history nor civilization.
Since the pitch-black calamity from five hundred years ago, they have begun to spread in large numbers across the land. They are not very strong, and they lack organization, but they nonetheless bring sizable trouble to humans every once in a while.

customize.name: Large Hydro Slime
customize.desc:
A monster created by the sedimentation of Hydro dispersed throughout nature.
A larger and more powerful Hydro Slime that can create bubbles to entrap its enemies. It is said that they can grow to truly staggering sizes if given an energy-rich environment. Eyewitnesses have supposedly seen Hydro Slimes as large as a small mound in Wolvendom.

customize.name: Hydro Slime
customize.desc:
A small monster created by the sedimentation of Hydro dispersed throughout nature.
Legend has it that some people would use Hydro Slimes as an emergency water source, packing them in preparation for travels through dry regions or deep domains. But due to the high concentration of Hydro within these slimes, direct ingestion is, in fact, harmful to the human body.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff73>After defeating them, Huginn will uncover an Exquisite Chest, which</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>must interact with to progress the Quest.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Talk to Tolfin</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Follow Huginn and look for clues</color>

<color=#ffffff73>After chatting with Tolfin, follow Huginn again.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>To catch the mole, order Huginn to stand in one of the holes, then stand in the other one to catch it.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>After reaching the room with the waypoint,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>will find another Sergent Octopus.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Stop the out-of-control machine</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Find spare parts</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Jump over the Sergeant Octopus electric attacks.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>When</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>reaches it, interact to stop it and advance the quest.</color>
The player <color=#ffffff73>will search and find the spare parts.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Follow Huginn and find a way to return to the surface</color>

<color=#ffffff73>The cavern has collapsed, locking</color> the player's group in.
<color=#ffffff73>Follow Huginn, who will lead</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>to a journal.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>After the short interaction, interact again to uncover a kuuvahki robot.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>With its kuuvahki field,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>will be able to destroy a nearby wall and escape the underground, now just ride the lift back up.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Return to Colonel Iron Whale</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Talk to Zhorik</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Wake Colonel Iron Whale up</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Return to the machine.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>After a brief chat sequence, install the spare parts.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Ride the "Aurora" and search for "treasure"</color>

<color=#ffffff73>After activating the Colonel Iron Whale, moonlanes will appear.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Ride the moonlanes to progress, entering a challenge mode.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Collect all the energy orbs</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>comes across.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Make sure to swap lanes in order to not miss any of them.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Talk to Paimon</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Talk to Zhorik</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Talk to Tolfin</color>

<color=#ffffff73>After completing the challenge,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>will enter a dialogue sequence.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>By the end of it,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>will obtain</color>

customize.name: Stratagema-Cognoscenti's Mask
customize.desc: A cold mask that once concealed a true face. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders. No adornments grace the mask but for the frosty moonlight that dances across its pure silver facade.

customize.text:
<color=#ece5d8>Blue Amber Lake, Nod-Krai</color>
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>A group of people, each with their own story to tell, lights a bonfire at Blue Amber Lake...</color>
Quest Objective: Check near the campfire
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> The honey brewed for the few turned into bitter wine, yet it could not extinguish the flames of self-reproach in his heart...
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> This deep underground? It doesn't look like there would be a workshop here at all... more like a mole's house than anything else!
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> So it's a tragedy, isn't it? He gave up the reward, and when he returned home, nothing was the same...
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Why tell the story of a fool like him? If it were me, I'd have stayed on that island. Apples aren't my favorite, but that'd hardly be an issue.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Looks like we have new friends joining us.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hehe, this is a nice place to rest. Are you all telling stories?
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Tch, more people...
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> Zhorik, be nice. Sorry, he's probably feeling unwell. Been like this since we left Novokitezhgrad...
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Let us introduce ourselves first. I'm Tolfin. As you can see, I deal in little odds and ends and tell a few stories.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> These two are Mr. and Mrs. Shesternin, who are on their way back to Novokitezhgrad from Nasha Town, I believe. This trail is a tough one. Brave of you two to make the attempt.
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> Ah... We have our reasons for coming here, but that's personal and a long story, so let's leave it at that.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> It's our turn now, right? Paimon's Paimon, and he/she is Traveler. We're adventurers, just passing by.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Oh? Then you must have heard of Reed Miller's Great Treasure. They say that the key to unlocking its secret lies within the five Proofs of the Cognoscenti.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Treasure hunting is in the blood of an adventurer.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: For Paimon's sake, I must obtain the Great Treasure...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Y—You're doing this for Paimon? Paimon's touched... When we get the Great Treasure, she'll share half of it with you for sure, Traveler!
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Speaking of that, I've told many stories about Reed Miller, and I was fortunate enough to lay my eyes on a Proof of the Cognoscenti. One of them was even found by my friend.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Coincidentally, this very spot we're resting at was built by that friend of mine. Knowing him, the Proof of the Cognoscenti might very well be here.
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> ...Are you talking about Papa Wrench?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Oh-ho, it appears my friend is quite famous. Back then, he was traveling between the islands with a caravan, and as it happened, I would have some dealings with them.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Come to think of it, his story is quite extraordinary. Although he lost his memory due to an accident, his skill in crafting and maintaining machinery is as remarkable as ever.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> And the very accident that caused his memory loss, that shipwreck from many years ago... I'm sure you've heard of it too, Mr. and Mrs. Shesternin. I believe him to be a survivor of that incident.
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> That's... Could there be such a coincidence...? Zhorik survived that incident, too... but my father wasn't as lucky.
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Danyusha, didn't we agree to leave all that behind?
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> Yes, I know... but lately I've been thinking... Father loved me — loved us — so much. Were he still alive, he wouldn't sit and let this happen...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Are you two in trouble? Perhaps we could help.
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> You? Right, you're adventurers... Then, could you find the Great Treasure for us?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Piece of cake.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> As long as the treasure exists, we will find it! But, we can't just let you take the Great Treasure off our hands for free either.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Sure, with fair compensation for honest work...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Heh, money, money, money... It all comes down to money in the end. Nothing's negotiable without Mora, is that it?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Why are you suddenly so agitated...? You're the one commissioning us to find something for you, so of course you need to compensate us.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> We enjoy helping others, sure, but it's not right to expect us to work for free!
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Working for free... The Papa Wrench I knew was exactly that sort of person.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Eh? But how would he make a living like that?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> He was lucky that the caravan leader looked after him. If it weren't for that, I don't think he would have lasted so long.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> He only charged nominal fees for making and repairing machinery. Sometimes he even did it for free. He did the same when it came to teaching others about machines, sharing his knowledge without reserve.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> The children in the caravan loved him too, because he had endless stories to tell... Though I should clarify, I could go toe to toe with him on that.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Too bad I didn't prepare candies for my audience like he did, though. His little listeners were, without exception, all captivated by the sweet candies and fantastical stories.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Now you've gotten Paimon all curious about meeting him! It must've been fun listening to his stories... Oh, Paimon wants to hear about how he found the Proof of the Cognoscenti!
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Unfortunately, he's no longer with us.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? But you were saying...
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> He built all the mechanical devices here for a child called Tinet. She was rendered eccentric and hard to get along with by an illness that tormented her.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> It took Papa Wrench quite some time to get close to her, too. These devices were originally made to make her happy and fulfill a small wish of hers...
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> But that poor child didn't make it. After that, Papa Wrench also passed away from his chronic illness and overwhelming grief.
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> *sigh*... How do you have so many sad stories to tell?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Madam, you're mistaken. Other than tragedies, I also have plenty of stories about righteous bandits robbing the rich to help the poor and tales of underdogs getting their revenge to share. But for now...
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Perhaps the two of you could provide some story material. How about a family-friendly treasure-hunting tale? The treasure in this case would, of course, be the Proof of the Cognoscenti that Papa Wrench left behind.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> He once said that, should he pass, all his belongings would be mine to handle as I see fit. I'm sure he wouldn't mind a couple of adventurers taking it in exchange for a great story.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> After a thrilling adventure by the mirror-sheened Blue Amber Lake, the two adventurers find the treasure at last. Cliche, perhaps, but a captivating evergreen tale nonetheless.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> What do you think?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> In that case, we'd be happy to. But umm, rather than our story, could you tell us more about Papa Wrench later?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Haha, no problem. Like I said, all the mechanical devices here were built to make Tinet happy. According to Papa Wrench's vision...
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Tinet would need go on a quest like a true adventurer — she'd have to collect lots of Stellafruit, deliver them to Sergeant Octopus, and pass the trial to awaken Colonel Iron Whale.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Then, the "Proof of the Cognoscenti" would be her reward. Hmm, that's all the hints I can give for now. If you two run into any difficulty, just think of this as extra spice in our story.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> It's alright, Papa Wrench wouldn't make anything too tough on purpose, right? This should be way easier than those mechanisms in the ruins.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Alright, then! Show me what you're capable of. Sergeant Octopus has command over two areas, and you can start the challenge from either one.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> As for you, Mr. and Mrs. Shesternin, since you're just passing through and don't intend to be held up by this treasure hunt, please excuse me if I accompany you no further.
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> ...Of course, but we'll stay here for a little while longer.
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> Zhorik, I know you'll still think me delusional, even if I tell you all this. But don't you think this is an opportunity?
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> ...Hmm. Opportunity, you say?
Quest Objective: Collect Stellafruit, deliver them to Sergeant Octopus, and pass the trial
Optional Dialogue: Talk to Tolfin
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Stellafruit only grow near Blue Amber Lake, and the climate here is indeed very different from everywhere else. The atmosphere in the air... is beyond words.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> You need to deliver enough Stellafruit before Sergeant Octopus will reveal the trial's contents. Well, since this is a fairy tale, I suppose it doesn't really count as "bribery."
Optional Dialogue: Talk to Zhorik Shesternin and Danyusha Shesternin
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> Yes. Since the Proof of the Cognoscenti is well within reach, we might have a chance at getting it too.
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> It may not be as valuable as the Great Treasure, but it's an essential key for those who covet said treasure...
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> ...Yes. You're right.
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> I think we could perhaps use it to buy ourselves some time to turn things around... Zhorik, are you listening?
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> I'm listening. You're right, you're right. However...
Optional Dialogue: Talk to Danyusha Shesternin
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> Will I make it in time...?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Are you leaving?
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> ...Oh! Yes, yes. I left something important in Nasha Town, so I should go back...
Optional Dialogue: Talk to Zhorik Shesternin
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> It must be here...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> What are you doing here?
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Not much. I just wanted to watch your treasure hunt from the place with the best view.
Quest Objective: Return to Colonel Iron Whale
Quest Objective: Wake Colonel Iron Whale up
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Hey! What did you guys do? This thing's moving, but how do I operate it...
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> It seems the device for awakening Colonel Iron Whale is missing some parts. That figures. Even guarded treasures are coveted by others, let alone unguarded ones.
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> So the Proof of the Cognoscenti... the treasure is hidden here?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> It's certainly nearby, but...
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Why don't we just take it apart, then? It's little more than a pile of scrap anyway. This way, you won't have to play this little game of pretend anymore. Why not just make things easier?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: That's certainly one way to go about it...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hey! That's... Um, Paimon doesn't think that's right. Papa Wrench poured his heart into this after all. If we can just find the missing parts...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Time to spice up this story.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon's going to sneeze from all that spice! Hmm... there must be some other way! We just need to find the missing parts, right? Well, we're good at finding things.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> If we're talking about spare parts, I might have some leads.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wow, are you really giving us clues just like that?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> It's not unusual to receive aid from mysterious characters in stories, right? Mr. Shesternin, if you're also interested in the treasure's whereabouts, it's not too late to join us...
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Hah! I... I'm a collector, so of course I'm interested in the Proof of the Cognoscenti, but I won't play along with your childish games.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Well, you can certainly try to challenge Colonel Iron Whale your way. Let's see who can locate the treasure first. As for you, adventurers, please follow me.
Quest Objective: Head to the designated location
Quest Objective: Talk to Tolfin
Optional Dialogue: Talk to Zhorik Shesternin
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Just a hunk of metal junk...
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Papa Wrench's workshop is down this way. You should be able to find the spare parts there.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Then all we need to do is activate the lift, right? Paimon's got this... Huh? Where's the lever?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ah! A weasel thief!? Did it steal the lever?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Well, this is... unexpected. Don't worry, I'll handle things from here.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> You? But...
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Huginn! It's your turn to shine.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Eh!? And where did you come from!?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> It's not that unusual for traveling merchants to have a few clever companions, no? Quickly, let's catch up to it.
Quest Objective: Find the missing lift parts

<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Alright, let's head back. If we take too long, Mr. Shesternin might find the treasure before we do.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Huginn will lead the way. Just follow it.

<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What are you planning now, bringing us to this place?... Best be warned, Traveler's super strong!

Quest Objective: Follow Huginn and look for clues
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? What's going on here?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Hmm, it seems Sergeant Octopus isn't feeling well. Perhaps it's getting aggressive because it's not used to the environment. After all, underground caves aren't exactly where octopuses usually hang out.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Sergeant! Pull yourself together!</color>

<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I feel like you're implying something here...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> I've always respected the audience's freedom of interpretation. However, rather than that which lies between the lines, we have more pressing matters to address right now.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Looks like we'll have to get closer to make it stop. Well then, I'll leave it to you, Traveler and Paimon.
Quest Objective: Stop the out-of-control machine

Quest Objective: Find spare parts

<color=#ffffff>Three humans and a weasel search up and down, until you finally find the spare parts...</color>

<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I can't handle spicy food...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Don't worry, leave it to Huginn. Treasure-hunting isn't all it can do — it's also good at pathfinding.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> You see? Just follow its lead, and we're bound to find something good.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh, you... You're not gonna do anything yourself, are you? It's been on us or your Weasel Thief this whole time.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Haha, I suppose it's a kind of family tradition. Those who are bolder oft shall lead the charge, while all we can do is chronicle their feats and sing their praises.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Alright, our adventure isn't over yet. The Proof of the Cognoscenti awaits, so let's head out now.
Quest Objective: Follow Huginn and find a way to return to the surface
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Same handwriting as earlier... Wait, Danyusha... Zhorik?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Is Danyusha Papa Wrench's daughter, then? But Paimon thought he fell into the sea because of an accident that happened ten years ago aboard the Fortunate One.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> *sigh* Huginn, you just had to dig this page out, didn't you? I guess I have no choice but to...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon knew you were up to no good! Traveler, draw your sword, quick!
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> ...No choice but to tell you all my plans now, and ask that you pretend you know nothing from this point on.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> ...Huh?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> I was there the day Papa Wrench saw the obituary. He had a strange look on his face, so I asked him about the matter. Even so, he kept insisting that he couldn't remember the details from ten years ago.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Always assuming the best of others... That's just the way he was. Besides, he had Tinet to care for, so everything else took a backseat.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> After he passed, I kept my ear to the ground, and what do you know? News reached me that the Shesternins had exhausted their wealth over the last ten years and had landed in serious debt.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> So, I sent a messenger to tell a story. "Have you heard? The Proof of the Cognoscenti that can lead you to the Great Treasure is at the Blue Amber Lake in Nod-Krai"...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> You were going to give him the Proof of the Cognoscenti?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Technically, it is Papa Wrench... Mr. Shesternin Sr.'s inheritance. As his legal heir, Zhorik has the right to it.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> I'm not as charitable as ol' Papa, but I wanted to give Zhorik a chance to prove himself. And that's how the treasure hunt came to be.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> He's not interested in the story or the setting, but he seems determined to get the Proof all the same. It's entirely possible that he might find it before you two.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> That won't do!
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Indeed. Therefore, my plan is to ask you to interfere with the process... or should I say, "finders keepers" — as long as you get it before him, of course.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Though if your conscience permits, you can let him find it first before taking it off his hands. Not a terrible strategy either, that.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> So that's your plan... Paimon doesn't get it! Do you want him to have it or not? And, what if we didn't come this way? What was your original plan?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> A scheme abandoned hardly matters in the present, does it? I have great faith in your treasure-hunting skills.
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> When we go back out, please pretend you've heard nothing. It would not do for me to appear biased, after all.

<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hehe, we won! The Proof of the Cognoscenti is ours now!
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> W—Well... congratulations. But are you really going to activate the device right now? This thing looks like it's been out of use for a while, there might be some malfunction...
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Mr. Shesternin, are you worried that such a malfunction might hurt one of us? How thoughtful. However, with the treasure within our reach, it would be too much to ask us to simply ignore it.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Yeah, that's right! Traveler, let's install the parts and start it up right now!

<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? Th—That's...

<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Before we show you, take a look at this.
<color=#ffffff>You show the picture from earlier to Zhorik...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> ...What is this trickery!? Who commissioned you to do this? Was it that old man? Is he still alive? Where is he!?

<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Papa Wrench... So, he lured me here with a fake name so he can have his revenge, is that it? You think you can take me?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Revenge? What are you talking about?... Wait, so the one who pushed Papa Wrench off the ship was...
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> Drop the act. You're all working for that old man, aren't you? Wait... Does Danyusha know? Is she in on this too?
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> That woman... She agreed so quickly because she knew this was a trap all along, didn't she? Offering to deliver the letter, doing all that, just to isolate me...?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: That's right. It's over.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: You're getting ahead of yourself...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik Shesternin:</color> No. Not one of you will ever get me! Not you, and not that old man!
<color=#ffffff>Zhorik scurries away, not even bothering with the precious goblet he mistook for the Proof of the Cognoscenti...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Are you just letting him go? We don't have any grudge against him, but isn't Papa Wrench your friend?
<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Don't worry. The path he took looks most dangerous. I would not be surprised if something happens to him.

<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> Alas, like many others, he too is a prisoner to his baser instincts. What a tragedy.

<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Feels like a freebie... but wait! We worked hard for it too! It's our just reward!

<color=#ffffff>Tolfin:</color> I guess I'll come visit Colonel Iron Whale from time to time.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: About the Proofs of the Cognoscenti...</color>

Optional Dialogue: Talk to Danyusha Shesternin
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> Where did he go...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> What brings you here?
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> ...Oh, I'm waiting for Zhorik. Do you know where he went? We agreed to meet back here with his friend from Nasha Town.
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> But they haven't shown up... I'm worried that something might have happened to them. Tolfin did advise against taking this route earlier...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> (Should I tell the truth about Zhorik and Papa Wrench?...)
<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> If you see Zhorik around, could you tell him that I'm waiting for him here?

<color=#ffffff>Traveler: There's something about Zhorik that I must tell you...</color>

<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> ...

<color=#ffffff>Danyusha Shesternin:</color> *sigh* Why did you have to tell me all this... I always thought I had no chance of recovering what was lost...
